ownerNativeReport.boundedResult: Real Windows OEM and WSL maintenance episodes instantiate the research consequences without requiring new Basis-specific engineering. Signed driver updates were admitted while firmware/BIOS mutation was deferred because the current WSL-hosted control channel lacked an independent reboot/recovery path. Reconstructible download/extraction/workspace material was deleted after preserving exact identity/provenance/postcondition evidence, while current qcow parents, Vault authority and source ISO were retained where dependency/reconstructibility standing differed.
ownerNativeReport.currentFrontier: A future prospectively informative case would require owner-native practice to fail the option/recovery implication: for example admitting an irreversible action without adequate continuation/recovery standing, deleting apparently reconstructible material that later becomes unrecoverable, or changing a consumer judgment under a mechanism-matched projection.
ownerNativeReport.newCounterexample: Option preservation does not imply retaining all bytes, and delay is not inherently conservative: deleting reconstructible material can increase execution headroom without meaningful future-option loss, while waiting on firmware can increase later admissibility only because the future recovery/execution envelope changes.
ownerNativeReport.ownerBoundary: Basis has real operational analogues and bounded transfer success, but importing Basis terminology would not have changed the observed actions. Status is REAL_CONSUMER_SATISFIED / NO_INCREMENTAL_ENGINEERING; no global scheduler, retention service, option-value field or irreversible-action policy is earned.
